thig11.1:1.1: samatto. || ubho mātā ca dhītā ca mayaṃ āsuṃ sapattiyo | tassā me ahu saṃvego abbhuto lomahaṃsano. || ||
thig11.1:2.1: dhi-r-atthu kāmā asucī duggandhā bahukaṇṭakā | yattha mātā ca dhītā ca sabhariyā mayaṃ ahuṃ. || ||
thig11.1:3.1: kāmesv ādīnavaṃ disvā nekkhammaṃ daḷhakhemato | sā pabbajiṃ Rājagahe agārasmā anagāriyaṃ. || ||
thig11.1:4.1: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ | ceto paricca ñāṇañ ca sotadhātu visodhitā. || ||
thig11.1:5.1: iddhi pi me sacchikatā patto me āsavakkhayo | cha me abhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ || ||
thig11.1:6.1: iddhiyā abhinimmitvā caturassaṃ rathaṃ ahaṃ | buddhassa pāde vanditvā lokanāthassa sirīmato. || ||
thig11.1:7.1: supupphitaggaṃ upagamma pādapaṃ ekā tuvaṃ tiṭṭhasi rukkhamūle | na cāpi te dutiyo atthi koci na tvaṃ bāle bhāyasi dhuttakānaṃ. || ||
thig11.1:8.1: sataṃ sahassānaṃ pi dhuttakānaṃ samāgatā edisakā bhaveyyuṃ | lomaṃ na iñje na pi sampavedhe kiṃ me tuvaṃ Māra karissas' eko || ||
thig11.1:9.1: esā antaradhāyāmi kucchiṃ vā pavisāmi te | bhamukantare tiṭṭhāmi tiṭṭhantiṃ maṃ na dakkhisi. || ||
thig11.1:10.1: cittamhi vasībhūtāhaṃ iddhipādā subhāvitā | cha me abhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thig11.1:11.1: sattisūlūpamā kāmā khandhānaṃ adhikuṭṭanā | yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi arati dāni sā mama. || ||
thig11.1:12.1: sabbattha vihatā nandi tamokkhandho padālito | evaṃ jānāhi pāpima nihato tvam asi antakā ti. || ||
